title: Travel-Day Rates for Premium Economy Upgrades
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — timing of a paid upgrade into Premium Economy.** The Premium Economy upgrade price is multiplied by the **travel-day rate**, which follows the whole days from today to the segment's scheduled departure date. The rate acts on the unrounded price; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Whole days from today to the scheduled departure date | Travel-day rate |
|---|---|
| 0: travel today | 0.85 (departure-day rate) |
| 1 to 3 (near-travel days) | 0.95 |
| 4 or more | 1 |

The segment is the ticket's first unflown segment, and its scheduled departure date is the ticket's next scheduled departure.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, segment departing 9 October)

| Today | Days | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 9 October | 0 | 0.85 |
| 8 October | 1 | 0.95 |
| 6 October | 3 | 0.95 |
| 5 October | 4 | 1 |
